headline.sentence: Doobydobap makes food and travel videos for 3,200,000 followers on TikTok and 4,480,000 on YouTube, sends a newsletter, and runs her own website, but has no store or membership, and she is posting 2.3 videos a month against 5.1 before, with recent videos getting 49% fewer views.

(360,738 views)
